title.de: Der Superlativ: the biggest, the best
title.it: Il superlativo: the biggest, the best

goal.sl: Izbereš enega izmed treh ali več s the + -est in the most, pišeš the biggest in the happiest, rečeš the best, the worst, the furthest ter dodaš in the village ali of the three.
goal.de: Du greifst einen aus dreien oder mehr heraus mit the + -est und the most, schreibst the biggest und the happiest, sagst the best, the worst, the furthest und ergänzt in the village oder of the three.
goal.it: Scegli uno tra tre o più con the + -est e the most, scrivi the biggest e the happiest, dici the best, the worst, the furthest e aggiungi in the village o of the three.
goal.en: You can pick one out of three or more with the + -est and the most, spell the biggest and the happiest, say the best, the worst, the furthest, and add in the village or of the three.

say.sl: Ko izbereš enega izmed treh ali več: **the** + **-est**: **old, the oldest** (star, najstarejši); **young, the youngest** (mlad, najmlajši). **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.** (Stari Wilf je najstarejši mož v vasi.) **Alfie is the youngest of the children.** (Alfie je najmlajši med otroki.) **the** ostane, nikoli *Wilf is oldest man*.
say.de: Wenn du einen aus dreien oder mehr herausgreifst: **the** + **-est**: **old, the oldest** (alt, der älteste); **young, the youngest** (jung, der jüngste). **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.** (Der alte Wilf ist der älteste Mann im Dorf.) **Alfie is the youngest of the children.** (Alfie ist das jüngste der Kinder.)
say.it: Per scegliere uno tra tre o più: **the** + **-est**: **old, the oldest** (vecchio, il più vecchio); **young, the youngest** (giovane, il più giovane). **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.** (Il vecchio Wilf è l'uomo più anziano del paese.) **Alfie is the youngest of the children.** (Alfie è il più piccolo dei bambini.)
say.en: To pick one out of three or more: **the** + **-est**: **old, the oldest**; **young, the youngest**. **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.** (never *Old Wilf is oldest man in the village.*) **Alfie is the youngest of the children.**

say.sl: Pravopis je tak kot pri **-er**: **nice, the nicest** (najprijetnejši); **big, the biggest** (največji); **hot, the hottest** (najbolj vroč); **happy, the happiest** (najsrečnejši); **busy, the busiest**; **easy, the easiest** (najlažji).
say.de: Die Schreibung ist wie bei **-er**: **nice, the nicest** (der netteste); **big, the biggest** (der größte); **hot, the hottest** (der heißeste); **happy, the happiest** (der glücklichste); **busy, the busiest**; **easy, the easiest** (der leichteste).
say.it: L'ortografia è come con **-er**: **nice, the nicest** (il più gentile); **big, the biggest** (il più grande); **hot, the hottest** (il più caldo); **happy, the happiest** (il più felice); **busy, the busiest**; **easy, the easiest** (il più facile).
say.en: The spelling is as with **-er**: **nice, the nicest**; **big, the biggest** (never *the bigest*); **hot, the hottest**; **happy, the happiest** (never *the happyest*); **busy, the busiest**; **easy, the easiest**.

say.sl: Dolge besede dobijo **the most**: **useful, the most useful** (najbolj koristen); **beautiful, the most beautiful** (najlepši); **expensive, the most expensive** (najdražji). Nikoli obojega: **the biggest**, nikoli *the most biggest*.
say.de: Lange Wörter bekommen **the most**: **useful, the most useful** (der nützlichste); **beautiful, the most beautiful** (der schönste); **expensive, the most expensive** (der teuerste). Nie beides: **the biggest**, nie *the most biggest*.
say.it: Le parole lunghe prendono **the most**: **useful, the most useful** (il più utile); **beautiful, the most beautiful** (il più bello); **expensive, the most expensive** (il più caro). Mai tutti e due: **the biggest**, mai *the most biggest*.
say.en: Long words take **the most**: **useful, the most useful**; **beautiful, the most beautiful**; **expensive, the most expensive**. Never both: **the biggest** (never *the most biggest*).

say.sl: Tri so posebne: **good, the best** (dober, najboljši); **bad, the worst** (slab, najslabši); **far, the furthest** (daleč, najdlje). **Arthur's honey is the best in Cumbria.** (Arthurjev med je najboljši v Cumbrii.) **That was the worst day of the year.** (To je bil najslabši dan v letu.) Tudi **the farthest** je prav. Nikoli *the goodest*.
say.de: Drei sind eigen: **good, the best** (gut, der beste); **bad, the worst** (schlecht, der schlechteste); **far, the furthest** (weit, am weitesten). **Arthur's honey is the best in Cumbria.** (Arthurs Honig ist der beste in Cumbria.) **That was the worst day of the year.** (Das war der schlechteste Tag des Jahres.) Auch **the farthest** ist richtig. Nie *the goodest*.
say.it: Tre sono a parte: **good, the best** (buono, il migliore); **bad, the worst** (cattivo, il peggiore); **far, the furthest** (lontano, il più lontano). **Arthur's honey is the best in Cumbria.** (Il miele di Arthur è il migliore della Cumbria.) **That was the worst day of the year.** (È stato il giorno peggiore dell'anno.) Anche **the farthest** è giusto. Mai *the goodest*.
say.en: Three stand alone: **good, the best** (never *the goodest*); **bad, the worst**; **far, the furthest**. **Arthur's honey is the best in Cumbria.** **That was the worst day of the year.** **the farthest** is right too.

say.sl: **in** gre s krajem ali skupino: **in the village** (v vasi), **in England** (v Angliji), **in the family** (v družini). **of** gre s številom ali časom: **of the three** (od treh), **of all** (od vseh), **of the year** (v letu). Za **my**, **Jack's** ni **the**: **my best friend** (moj najboljši prijatelj), **Jack's best dog** (Jackov najboljši pes).
say.de: **in** steht bei einem Ort oder einer Gruppe: **in the village** (im Dorf), **in England** (in England), **in the family** (in der Familie). **of** steht bei einer Zahl oder Zeit: **of the three** (von den dreien), **of all** (von allen), **of the year** (des Jahres). Nach **my**, **Jack's** kein **the**: **my best friend** (mein bester Freund), **Jack's best dog** (Jacks bester Hund).
say.it: **in** va con un luogo o un gruppo: **in the village** (del paese), **in England** (d'Inghilterra), **in the family** (della famiglia), mai *of the village*. **of** va con un numero o un tempo: **of the three** (dei tre), **of all** (di tutti), **of the year** (dell'anno). Dopo **my**, **Jack's** niente **the**: **my best friend** (il mio migliore amico), **Jack's best dog** (il cane migliore di Jack).
say.en: **in** goes with a place or a group: **in the village** (never *of the village*), **in England**, **in the family**. **of** goes with a number or a time: **of the three**, **of all**, **of the year**. After **my**, **Jack's** there's no **the**: **my best friend**, **Jack's best dog**.

say.sl: Dve stvari: **-er** + **than**. Tri ali več: **the -est**. **Jack is younger than Sam.** (Jack je mlajši od Sama.) **Alfie is the youngest of the children.** **Penrith is bigger than Keswick.** (Penrith je večji od Keswicka.) **Carlisle is the biggest place in Cumbria.** (Carlisle je največji kraj v Cumbrii.)

Bei dreien oder mehr: **the -est**. **Jack is younger than Sam.** (Jack ist jünger als Sam.) **Alfie is the youngest of the children.** **Penrith is bigger than Keswick.** (Penrith ist größer als Keswick.) **Carlisle is the biggest place in Cumbria.** (Carlisle ist der größte Ort in Cumbria.)
say.it: Tra due: **-er** + **than**. Tra tre o più: **the -est**. **Jack is younger than Sam.** (Jack è più giovane di Sam.) **Alfie is the youngest of the children.** **Penrith is bigger than Keswick.** (Penrith è più grande di Keswick.) **Carlisle is the biggest place in Cumbria.** (Carlisle è il posto più grande della Cumbria.)

exercises.text: Old Wilf is ___ (old) man in the village, and Alfie is ___ (young) of the children. Mrs Birkett is ___ (busy) person on the square. Arthur's honey is ___ (good) in Cumbria, and Granny Maggie's scones are ___ (nice) I know. — And ___ (bad) singer? — Auntie Edna, but she is ___ (happy) ___ all!

translation.sl: Stari Wilf je najstarejši mož v vasi, Alfie pa najmlajši med otroki. Gospa Birkett ima največ dela na trgu. Arthurjev med je najboljši v Cumbrii, sconi babice Maggie pa so najboljši, kar jih poznam. — In najslabša pevka? — Teta Edna, a je najsrečnejša od vseh!
translation.de: Der alte Wilf ist der älteste Mann im Dorf, und Alfie ist das jüngste der Kinder. Frau Birkett hat am Platz am meisten zu tun. Arthurs Honig ist der beste in Cumbria, und Oma Maggies Scones sind die besten, die ich kenne. — Und die schlechteste Sängerin? — Tante Edna, aber sie ist die glücklichste von allen!
translation.it: Il vecchio Wilf è l'uomo più anziano del paese, e Alfie è il più piccolo dei bambini. La signora Birkett è la persona più occupata della piazza. Il miele di Arthur è il migliore della Cumbria, e gli scones di nonna Maggie sono i più buoni che conosco. — E la cantante peggiore? — Zia Edna, ma è la più felice di tutti!
translation.en: Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village, and Alfie is the youngest of the children. Mrs Birkett is the busiest person on the square. Arthur's honey is the best in Cumbria, and Granny Maggie's scones are the nicest I know. — And the worst singer? — Auntie Edna, but she is the happiest of all!

translation.en: Cumbria has got the highest mountain in England, Scafell Pike, and the biggest lake, Windermere. Some people say Keswick is the most beautiful town in the Lakes, but the best scones are in our village!
